sql: with w as (select floor(fish_date_t/7) wk, cls, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) a, count(*) n from trips where fish_date_t > (select max(fish_date_t) from trips) - 35 group by 1,2), p as (select floor(ts_t/7) wk, avg(wtmp_c)*9/5+32 f from pier group by 1) select w.wk, cls, n, yt, a, round(yt/nullif(a,0),2) r, round(p.f,1) pierF from w left join p using(wk) order by wk, cls

select fish_date_season s, floor(fish_date_doy/14)*14 d, round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),2) r, count(*) n from trips where cls in ('overnight','day_1_5') and fish_date_doy between 112 and 320 group by 1,2 order by 1,2
